name: Count Gwyridden
description: A daoine sith count of the Crun Clach faerie court who has played shinty for centuries; proud and conceited, sworn to Caitlin, and a champion shinty player among faeries.

name: Oenghus Dubh
description: Mortal shinty champion of Crun Clach, warm and friendly, the only mortal living in the second level of the hill's regio; better at shinty than Count Gwyridden despite never practicing.

name: Caitlin Suil Uaine
description: Maga who leads the covenant of Crun Clach, won the hill from the Prince of the Grey Jerkin at shinty, keeps a stable of faerie horses and maintains diplomacy with sith and neighboring tribunals.

name: Prince of the Grey Jerkin
description: Faerie prince (Faerie Might 35) who lost his hill to Crun Clach at shinty, now a pauper who challenges the covenant to rematches every few decades and creates monsters to harass it.

name: Am Balla
description: Being at Crun Clach who will gladly make stone containers for potions, provided the potions do not stain or corrode the rock.

name: Calum Mac Lachlan
description: A 135-year-old gruagach and magus Ex Miscellanea, effective head of the covenant of Mac Gruagach, who seeks to integrate Highland gruagach magic with Hermetic magic; gnarled, fur-covered and smelling of rotting vegetation.

name: Domnhull Beg
description: Magus of House Bonisagus, son of the clan chief, trained at Durenmar to integrate gruagach magic with Hermetic magic; holds the covenant's Hermetic title and dreams of founding a new House for the gruagach.

name: Mungan Mor
description: Magus Ex Miscellanea of Mac Gruagach trained as an animal mage, master of the clan's herds who drives them to the Lowlands each autumn.

name: Mairi Sean
description: Maga Ex Miscellanea of Mac Gruagach, a spirit mistress trained in Greece (Thebes tribunal) who summons ghosts of the Picts and is fixated on the Broch-builders.

name: Fearghus Mac Mungan
description: Magus Ex Miscellanea, cousin of Mungan Mor and apprentice of Mairi Sean, who studies the sluagh; lost a foot to a brollachan and has a secret drinking problem.

name: Aonghus Lamh Iarran
description: Magus Ex Miscellanea and war leader of Clan Mac Gruagach, addicted to cattle raiding, who enchants his arms and armor and enjoys challenging visitors to certamen.

name: Nechtan Dubh
description: Gruagach of Mac Gruagach trained by Brude Deathless, a descendant and favorite student of Brude, free with his Curses and Gifts.

name: Donncadh Mac Calum
description: Chief of Clan Mac Gruagach, a former hell-raiser now worn down by old wounds, who dreads passing the clan to his son Raibert and struggles to check his brother Lachlan.

name: Lachlan Mac Calum
description: Younger brother of Donncadh and seanachaidh of Clan Mac Gruagach, a storyteller knowledgeable about Highland supernatural beings who expects to inherit the chieftainship.

name: Raibert Mac Donncadh
description: Son of Donncadh and tanist of Clan Mac Gruagach, a reckless hell-raiser and warrior friendly with Aonghus Lamh Iarran.

name: Mairi Falt Ban
description: Wife of Donncadh Mac Calum and unofficial leader of the women of Clan Mac Gruagach, a calming influence with considerable say in clan matters.

name: Brude Deathless
description: The most powerful gruagach in Loch Leglean (Magic Resistance 60), who joined Pralix in the war against Damhan-allaidh, abducts children to train as gruagachan in his tower in Strathnavar, and lays Geasa and Curses.

name: Nechtan Mac Brude
description: Pictish gruagach, son of Brude Deathless, who led Clan Mac Gruagach in 814 and kept it neutral; died in 987.

name: Damhan-allaidh
description: Enemy chased into Scotland by the Order of Hermes in 814; the war against him is the root of House Flambeau's prejudice against Scots.

name: Pralix
description: Figure whom Brude Deathless joined in the war against Damhan-allaidh.

name: Diana nam Grechanach
description: Young Greek girl from the Isle of Boetia training under Mairi Sean, sent by Demetrios of Athens; skilled in medicine.

name: Demetrios of Athens
description: Mairi Sean's pater, a master of spirits in Greece, who sent Diana nam Grechanach to Mairi when his familiar died.

name: Chrétien de Troyes
description: Author of courtly romances about King Arthur that fascinate the osprey familiar Cagair an t-Aile.

name: King Arthur
description: Legendary king whose knights' deeds in romances fascinate Cagair an t-Aile.

name: Chearlach Mac Caolin
description: Young gruagach once of the covenant of Eilean Beg, abducted and trained by Brude Deathless, bound by a geas to train a student before his forty-ninth year.

name: Uierna of House Bonisagus
description: Bonisagus magus whose quoted account describes the gruagachan and their magic in Scotland.

name: Duncan the Bold
description: Example clan warrior who suffers a Geas and Curse from Brude Deathless, is Gifted by the Old Woman of the Heather, and has his Geas lifted by Domnhull Beg.

name: Old Woman of the Heather
description: Local witch known to grant Gifts, who gifts Duncan the Bold with Withstand Magic.

name: Cagair an t-Aile
description: Domnhull Beg's osprey familiar (Whisper of the Wind), who reads over his shoulder and loves courtly romances and Arthurian legend.

name: Marbhairn na Gearr-fhiadh
description: Mungan Mor's familiar (Hare Killer), an old grizzled deerhound with a long rivalry with Fiacail Geur.

name: Fiacail Geur
description: Aonghus Lamh Iarran's deerhound familiar (Sharp Tooth), feuding with Mungan's familiar.

name: Geamair
description: Mairi Sean's owl familiar (Gamekeeper), able to see spirits.

name: An Caora Dubh
description: The Black Ram, a man-eating faerie monster (Faerie Might 24) created by the Prince of the Grey Jerkin to harass Crun Clach; vulnerable to rowan and bells.

name: Each Sith
description: Faerie horse bred for high faeries of the seelie court, able to run over water; Caitlin keeps about a dozen at Crun Clach.

name: Sith
description: The faerie folk of Scotland, also called the people of peace and the good folk, who inhabit Crun Clach's hill.

name: Daoine Sith
description: High faeries of the sith court, such as Count Gwyridden.

name: Brownie
description: Lowly household faerie servant; even brownies at Crun Clach claim noble titles.

name: Brollachan
description: Shapeless monster inhabiting secluded lochs and glens; one cost Fearghus Mac Mungan his foot.

name: Sluagh
description: The undead host, studied by Fearghus Mac Mungan.

name: Giants
description: Beings of the Highlands from whom gruagachan are descended.

name: Crun Clach
description: Covenant in a faerie hill in Kintyre, won at shinty from the Prince of the Grey Jerkin, led by Caitlin and inhabited largely by faerie retainers.

name: Mac Gruagach
description: Covenant forming part of Clan Mac Gruagach, spread through Glen Glas, effectively headed by the gruagach Calum Mac Lachlan.

name: Eilean Beg
description: Covenant where Uierna met the young gruagach Chearlach Mac Caolin.

name: Durenmar
description: Domus magna of House Bonisagus, where Domnhull Beg trained.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House that admits Highland magicians including gruagachan; most Highland magi belong to it.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House whose domus magna Durenmar trained Domnhull Beg.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House with, alongside Ex Miscellanea, the largest number of magi in the Lowlands.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House whose magi are unlikely to accept Scots as apprentices, a prejudice dating to Pralix and the war against Damhan-allaidh.

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: The Hermetic tribunal of Scotland, in which Calum Mac Lachlan is reputed powerful and Highland hermit magi have full votes.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal with whose covenants Caitlin's diplomacy has averted conflicts.

name: Hibernia Tribunal
description: Tribunal with whose covenants Caitlin's diplomacy has averted conflicts.

name: Thebes Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Mairi Sean was trained as a spirit mistress.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi, which chased Damhan-allaidh into Scotland in 814 and which Clan Mac Gruagach seeks to integrate with.

name: Clan Mac Gruagach
description: Highland clan ('children of the son of the wizard') of long magical association, led by chief Donncadh Mac Calum, of which the covenant is a part.

name: Seelie Court
description: Faerie court whose high faeries ride the each sith.

name: Unseelie Fairies
description: Hostile faeries against whom bells are worn during rades.

name: Vikings
description: Raiders repelled by Crun Clach in the late 10th century; Danish Viking descendants live in the Islands and northern Highlands.

name: Picts
description: Ancient pre-Scots people of Scotland whose spirits Mairi Sean summons and whose language gruagachan speak.

name: Broch-builders
description: Forgotten race who built the brochs; Mairi Sean's magic does not work on their ghosts.

name: Scottish Church
description: The Church in Scotland, a specialty of Calum's Church Lore.

name: Gruagach
description: Highland magician descended from giants, using Exceptional Talents as magic, trained by an older gruagach; also means monster or wizard.

name: Freiceadanan
description: Covenant guards (grogs); at Crun Clach ten who hunt the Prince's monsters, at Mac Gruagach the entire clan.

name: Galloglaich
description: Heavy infantry of the Danish islanders who wear cotte or chain hauberk and carry two-handed axes; a character template.

name: Seanachaidh
description: Clan storyteller and historian office, held by Lachlan Mac Calum.

name: Tanist
description: Heir-designate of a Highland clan chief, held by Raibert Mac Donncadh.

name: Aonaranan
description: Highland hermit magi, some of whom attend Calum's court; hermits hold full tribunal votes.

name: Border Rider
description: Character template for horsemen of the Border families.

name: Clansman
description: Character template for ordinary Highland clan warriors.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Flaw common among Highland magi; gruagachan's Hermetic status is equivalent to it outside Ex Miscellanea.

name: Kintyre
description: Long peninsula of the kingdom of Man and the Isles where Crun Clach is located.

name: Kingdom of Man and the Isles
description: Kingdom ruled by the Norse king of Man, to which Kintyre belongs.

name: Island of Man
description: Vis-rich island visited by many covenants including Crun Clach.

name: Glen Glas
description: Valley where the buildings of the covenant of Mac Gruagach are spread, with a Magic aura of 0 to 5.

name: Strathnavar
description: Remote region where Brude Deathless has his tower.

name: Loch Ness
description: Loch whose vis is said to block scrying spells.

name: Scottish Highlands
description: Interior of Scotland and the Islands, faerie-rich, Gaelic-speaking and organized into clans.

name: Scottish Lowlands
description: Borders and east coast strip of Scotland including towns; cattle fairs held there.

name: The Borders
description: Lowland region of raiding and feuding Border families.

name: Aberdeen
description: East coast town marking the northern extent of the Lowlands.

name: Ettrick Forest
description: Lowland forest whose inhabitants use bows.

name: Caithness
description: Northern region where Highlanders speak Norse.

name: Scotland
description: Country of the Loch Leglean Tribunal, divided into Highlands and Lowlands.

name: Arcadia
description: Faerie otherworld where the Prince takes mortal recruits until the game.

name: Isle of Boetia
description: Greek home of Diana nam Grechanach.

name: Provence
description: Source of the courtly romances Cagair craves.

name: Enchantment to Block the Assault of Iron
description: Rego Terram 20 spell by Domnhull Beg, focused on an iron ring, enchanting an item that blocks attacks with substantial metal components.

name: Enchantment to Block the Assault of Wood
description: Rego Herbam 20 spell by Domnhull Beg, focused on a wooden ring, blocking attacks with substantial wooden components.

name: Shield of Mystic Might
description: Rego Terram 35 spell (Herbam requisite) combining the two Enchantment to Block spells, blocking all metal or wooden attacks; focus an iron and wood ring.

name: Obliteration of the Metallic Barrier
description: Perdo Terram 20 spell for which Domnhull's oak staff talisman is a focus.

name: Wielding the Invisible Sling
description: Rego Terram 10 spell for which Domnhull's oak staff talisman is a focus.

name: Cloak of Mist
description: Muto Corpus 45 effect by which the Prince's gray leather jerkin can turn its wearer to mist three times a day.

name: Eyes of the Past
description: Scrying spell that runs into anti-scrying defenses in the Mac Gruagach murder story.

name: Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie
description: Truth-detecting spell that magi refuse to have cast on themselves in the murder story.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Protective ritual; each house of Mac Gruagach has its own, as the glen is too large for one.

name: Gray Leather Jerkin of the Prince
description: The Prince of the Grey Jerkin's enchanted jerkin (protection 15) that repels wooden objects and can turn the wearer to mist.

name: Prince's Magical Caman
description: Magical caman of the Prince that drives a ball twice as far and makes it turn twice in flight (ReTe(An) 15).

name: Enchanted Caman of Count Gwyridden
description: Gwyridden's enchanted shinty stick.

name: Domnhull's Oak Staff Talisman
description: Domnhull Beg's talisman with bonuses to destroy, control, project bolt, repel and protection from storms.

name: Caman
description: Walking stick and club used for shinty, like a golf club with a six-to-eight-inch head.

name: Dirk
description: Main Highland weapon, a large knife sixteen to twenty inches long, sometimes used with the targe.

name: Dart
description: Light javelin about three feet long used by Highlanders.

name: Long Ax
description: Light Highland ax with three-foot haft, often used as a walking stick.

name: Targe
description: Typical Highland shield of two layered planks covered in studded leather, often with a boss spike.

name: Knight Errant
description: +1 Background Virtue: you have been knighted and may bear arms and be addressed as sir, owing no fealty or service.

name: Death Prophecy
description: +2 Supernatural Virtue: a condition is placed on your death, and until it is met you cannot die.

name: Student of Brude
description: +1 Gruagach Virtue: trained by Brude Deathless, with prestige and access to External Soul, but a Geas to train a student by age forty-nine.

name: Shapeshifter
description: +3 Gruagach Exceptional Talent allowing gruagachan to change shape; every gruagach must have it.

name: Transform
description: +3 Gruagach Exceptional Talent allowing gruagachan to change the shape of others.

name: External Soul
description: +4 Gruagach Virtue: the gruagach's soul is placed in a hidden object, making the gruagach unkillable and ageless unless the object is damaged.

name: Geas
description: Exceptional Talent (+4, +2 for gruagachan) to lay a prohibition that invokes a Curse when broken.

name: Gift (Exceptional Talent)
description: Exceptional Talent (+4, +2 for gruagachan) granting Virtues or abilities or removing Flaws, tied to a prohibition.

name: Curse
description: Exceptional Talent (+4, +2 for gruagachan) that adds Flaws or reduces abilities, characteristics or Virtues until a lifting condition is met.

name: Latent Magical Ability
description: Virtue representing a potential gruagach, required for non-gruagach characters with more than one Exceptional Talent.

name: Exceptional Talent
description: Class of Virtues representing supernatural talents; gruagach magic is represented by them.

name: Withstand Magic
description: +2 Supernatural Virtue conferring +6 Magic Resistance.

name: Knack
description: Virtue granting a bonus to a specific activity.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: Virtue possessed by Count Gwyridden.

name: Self-confident
description: Virtue possessed by several characters.

name: Gang Leader
description: Virtue for leading a group, e.g. mortal shinty players.

name: Long-winded
description: Virtue possessed by Oenghus Dubh.

name: Ambidextrous
description: Virtue possessed by the Prince of the Grey Jerkin.

name: Adept Student
description: Virtue possessed by Calum and Domnhull.

name: Large
description: Virtue possessed by Calum Mac Lachlan.

name: Mastered Talent
description: Virtue possessed by Calum (Shapeshifter).

name: Leadership
description: Social Virtue that Curses, Geasa and Gifts cannot grant or revoke.

name: Enduring Magic
description: Hermetic Virtue possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Hermetic Prestige
description: Virtue possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Magical Affinity
description: Virtue granting affinity with an Art (Domnhull's Vim); unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Prestigious Family
description: Virtue possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Good Arms
description: Virtue possessed by Donncadh Mac Calum.

name: Strong-willed
description: Virtue possessed by Donncadh Mac Calum.

name: Well-known
description: Virtue possessed by Donncadh Mac Calum.

name: Faerie Eyes
description: Virtue possessed by the each sith.

name: True Faith
description: Divine True Virtue that cannot be granted or revoked by Gifts or Curses.

name: True Love
description: Divine True Virtue that cannot be granted or revoked by Gifts or Curses.

name: Educated
description: Specialized knowledge Virtue unaffected by Curses or Gifts.

name: Arcane Lore
description: Specialized knowledge Virtue unaffected by Curses or Gifts.

name: Heart-Beast
description: Virtue unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Will Over Form
description: Virtue unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Hidden Shape
description: Virtue unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Faerie Blood
description: Virtue unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Faerie Magic
description: Virtue unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Magical Resistance
description: Virtue unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Werewolf
description: Virtue/Flaw unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Immortal
description: Virtue unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Trained as a Gruagach
description: -4 Hermetic Flaw: mistakenly trained as a gruagach for a year, giving -1 to Parma Magica and Art scores.

name: Afflicted Tongue
description: -1 Physical Flaw (-3 for magi and gruagachan): speech impediment giving -2 to voice rolls and an extra botch die when casting.

name: Palsied Hands
description: -2 Physical Flaw: shaking hands give -2 to holding objects and an extra botch die for gesture-based magic.

name: Geas (Flaw)
description: Variable Supernatural Flaw: a Geas has been cast on you and breaking it invokes its Curse.

name: Feud
description: Variable Background Flaw: your family is in a feud, from -1 new to -3 bloodbath, -1 more if supernatural.

name: Oath of Fealty
description: Flaw binding a character in fealty, e.g. to Caitlin.

name: Sense of Doom
description: Flaw possessed by Gwyridden and the Prince.

name: Sensitive
description: Flaw possessed by Count Gwyridden (dirty clothes).

name: Social Handicap
description: Flaw possessed by Gwyridden and Calum.

name: Susceptible to Divine Power
description: Flaw possessed by Count Gwyridden.

name: Vulnerable to Bells
description: Faerie weakness Flaw; faeries must flee bells.

name: Vulnerable to Iron
description: Faerie weakness Flaw.

name: Vulnerable to Rowan
description: Faerie weakness Flaw; rowan does double damage to many faeries.

name: Curse of Venus
description: Flaw possessed by Oenghus Dubh and the Prince.

name: Overconfident
description: Flaw possessed by Oenghus Dubh.

name: Softhearted
description: Flaw possessed by Oenghus Dubh.

name: Driving Goal
description: Flaw, e.g. the Prince's to regain Crun Clach or Domnhull's to integrate gruagach magic.

name: Indentured Servant
description: Flaw listed for the Prince (squire).

name: Infamous
description: Flaw: the Prince is a laughingstock.

name: Obsessed
description: Flaw: the Prince is obsessed with beating Caitlin.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Flaw possessed by Calum and Domnhull.

name: Isolated from the Order
description: Flaw common among Highland magi.

name: Lack of Potency
description: Flaw possessed by Calum Mac Lachlan.

name: Magic Susceptibility
description: Flaw possessed by Calum Mac Lachlan.

name: Obligation
description: Flaw obliging seasons of service to the clan.

name: One-handed
description: Flaw represented by Calum's withered claw.

name: Weak Magic
description: Flaw, Calum's in Curses.

name: Deficiency
description: Hermetic Flaw, Domnhull's in Auram.

name: Incompatible Arts
description: Hermetic Flaw, Domnhull's Intellego Auram.

name: No Natural Resistance
description: Flaw possessed by Domnhull; unavailable to gruagachan.

name: Rigid Magic
description: Hermetic Flaw possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Arthritis
description: Flaw possessed by Donncadh Mac Calum.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: Flaw possessed by Donncadh Mac Calum.

name: Poor Eyesight
description: Flaw possessed by Donncadh Mac Calum.

name: Poor Hearing
description: Flaw possessed by Donncadh Mac Calum.

name: Common Fear
description: -2 Mental Flaw laid by Brude's Curse on Duncan (fear of the moon).

name: Deep Sleeper
description: -1 Physical Flaw laid by Brude's Curse on Duncan.

name: Old
description: Flaw unavailable to gruagachan with External Soul.

name: Play Shinty
description: Physical Skill covering shooting, dribbling and blocking with the caman in shinty.

name: Gruagach Lore
description: Casual Knowledge of gruagachan, famous gruagachan and their connection to giants.

name: Speak Pictish
description: Ability to speak the lost Pictish language, available only to gruagachan, adding to casting totals of MR Talents.

name: Potency
description: Gruagach ability adding to casting totals of MR Talents, capped by Speak Pictish.

name: Gruagach Wisdom
description: Gruagach knowledge used like Magic Theory to research new Exceptional Talents and understand Geasa, Gifts and Curses.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Knowledge of faeries; Highland characters get a free score of 1.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic knowledge; Domnhull's specialty is integration.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic protective ability, penalized by the Trained as a Gruagach Flaw.

name: Penetration
description: Ability possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Finesse
description: Ability possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Hermes Lore
description: Knowledge of the Order of Hermes.

name: Hermes History
description: Knowledge of Hermetic history.

name: Hermes Law
description: Knowledge of Hermetic law.

name: Fantastic Beast Lore
description: Knowledge of fantastic beasts.

name: Legend Lore
description: Knowledge of legends.

name: Occult Lore
description: Knowledge of the occult.

name: Church Lore
description: Knowledge of the Church.

name: Enigmatic Wisdom
description: Ability possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Evaluate Vis
description: Ability possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Meditation
description: Ability possessed by Domnhull Beg.

name: Divination
description: Exceptional Talent (MR) for gruagachan.

name: Dousing
description: Exceptional Talent (MR) for finding water or lost objects.

name: Enchanting Music
description: Exceptional Talent (MR).

name: Entrancement
description: Exceptional Talent (MR).

name: Hex
description: Exceptional Talent (MR).

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: Exceptional Talent (MR).

name: Second Sight
description: Exceptional Talent (MR).

name: Sense Holiness
description: Exceptional Talent (MR).

name: Weather Sense
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Mimicry
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Perfect Balance
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Premonitions
description: Exceptional Talent (MR).

name: Visions
description: Exceptional Talent (MR).

name: Empathy
description: Exceptional Talent (MR).

name: Alchemy
description: Exceptional Talent valued 3 for gruagachan.

name: Animal Ken
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Contortions
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Direction Sense
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Healer
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Herbalism
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Read Lips
description: Exceptional Talent.

name: Pictish History
description: Mundane library subject at Mac Gruagach.

name: Athletics
description: Ability.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability.

name: Intrigue
description: Ability.

name: Area Lore
description: Knowledge of an area.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Art listed in the Mac Gruagach library and vis sources.

name: Shinty
description: Highland stick-and-ball game played with the caman to the first goal; the Prince and Crun Clach play for the hill.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power in pawns and rooks, found in creatures and places, e.g. Corpus vis from thatch.

name: Magic Aura
description: Supernatural aura; Mac Gruagach's averages 3 up to 5, and thatch vis requires at least 2.

name: Regio
description: Layered supernatural region; Crun Clach's hill has levels, mortals living on the first.

name: Glamour
description: Faerie illusion protecting Crun Clach's doorway; also a power of the Prince.

name: Rade
description: Faerie ride of the good folk, with bells on horses' manes.

name: Twilight
description: Wizards' Twilight, which Fearghus has neared through botches; Domnhull has Twilight Points.

name: Certamen
description: Hermetic magical duel; Aonghus challenges visitors to it.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to magic; gruagach MR Talents contribute to it; Brude's is 60.

name: Wizard's Sigil
description: Personal mark on a magus's magic; Domnhull's is a glow from his eyes.

name: Familiar
description: Magical animal bonded to a magus, with bond cords and qualities.

name: Talisman
description: Magus's attuned item, e.g. Domnhull's oak staff.

name: Domus Magna
description: Chief covenant of a House, e.g. Durenmar.

name: Faerie Might
description: Measure of a faerie creature's power.

name: Faerie Flight
description: Faerie power letting Count Gwyridden fly for 3 miles.

name: Change Size
description: Faerie power letting Gwyridden alter his Size by 2.

name: Poetic Justice
description: Rule adjusting the difficulty of Geasa, Gifts and Curses by their fit to the saga.

name: Magnitude
description: One-fifth of a magical effect's level, the Hermetic in-character measure of power.

name: Broch
description: Large thick-walled tower built by a forgotten race.

name: Ease Factor
description: Target number for casting Geasa, Gifts and Curses.

name: Spell Focus
description: Object aiding a spell, such as Domnhull's rings.

name: Hermetic Magic
description: Magic of the Order of Hermes, incompatible with Highland gruagach magic.

name: Gruagach Magic
description: Highland magic tradition represented by Exceptional Talents, incompatible with Hermetic magic.

name: Magic
description: Realm of Power whose auras fill Glen Glas.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of Power of the sith; Highlands are extremely faerie-rich.

name: Divine
description: Realm of Power; Gwyridden is susceptible to Divine power.
